comparison.objective: Lift and shake a sieve to separate soil from pebbles; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support and rhythmic shaking versus fine driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Soil passes through, pebbles remain, and sieve returns to supports versus locked angle and repeated gripper motion.
comparison.reason: Material separation by shaking is a different tested ability.
